note: Custer Gallatin NF (Sioux Ranger District) campground in the Slim Buttes near the Castles National Natural Landmark, NW South Dakota, ~20 mi SE of Buffalo: SD-20 to Forest Road 3126. One gravel loop in ponderosa pine; 2 group sites besides the 8 individual ones; fire ring and table at each site, no trash pickup. Spurs average 30-60 ft. --Claude
summary: FS page (updated May 2026) confirms 8 sites + 2 group, free, no water, vault toilets, all year weather dependent, 30-60 ft spurs; rec.gov 239838 info-only -> FCFS. Groups upgraded to manual; season year_round added. Not waterfront (dry buttes). Phone '' -> 605-797-4432 (Sioux RD).
